description: Vue template listeners are native listeners at their elements, added when Vue creates the element (IR schedule.elementListeners): listeners script adds after mount run after them at the same element and phase, in registration order, capture listeners at the target before its bubble listeners; stopPropagation in a script listener below an element keeps that element template listeners from running, and stopImmediatePropagation in a template listener keeps the script listeners of the element from running; nested dispatches from a listener (dispatchEvent of a MouseEvent, requestSubmit) follow the same order, and a microtask a listener queues runs after that listener. Not claimed: a capture listener at an ancestor stopping propagation keeps that ancestor's own bubbling listeners from running in Chromium, while both engines still run them (a dispatch gap of every framework, docs/gaps/PLATFORM.md; the fixture's mode-capture-stop button shows it)
